# Pagination

Page navigation with ellipsis

## Install

```bash
npx denseui@latest add pagination
```

npm dependencies: `@ark-ui/react`, `lucide-react`

Also installs: `button`

## Usage

```tsx
import { Pagination } from "@/components/ui/pagination"
```

## Example

```tsx
import { Pagination } from '@/components/ui/pagination'

export default function PaginationDemo() {
  return <Pagination count={240} pageSize={10} defaultPage={6} siblingCount={1} />
}
```
